addr: 2nd Floor, BHARTIYA CITY, Thanisandra Main Rd, Kannuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

rev.t:
Had a disappointing experience at Amoeba, Bhartiya City.

We visited on Tuesday because there was a 60% OFF offer on games displayed at …

The Happy Hours is just a scam. We ran get the happy hour but since the bowling lanes were full, they told we can't get the happy hour even though we reached before 11:30am. The staff said that mostly anyone who reaches post 11:00am do not get the happy hour offer. So anyone rushing to get this, slow down!
The experience is too good. All the games and bowling area is fantastic. The people over there are so humble and supportive.
